hero.title: Registered Dietitian & Nutrition Educator
hero.description: Helping people build sustainable, evidence-based relationships with food — one plate at a time.

description: Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) with 6 years of clinical and community nutrition experience. I specialise in medical nutrition therapy, weight management counselling, and preventive health education for diverse populations across Metro Manila and Central Luzon.

My approach is rooted in culturally-sensitive, person-centred care — I meet clients where they are, adapt traditional Filipino cuisine to therapeutic goals, and use behaviour-change science to drive lasting results.

experience.title: Senior Clinical Dietitian
responsibilities: Manage medical nutrition therapy for 40+ inpatients weekly across oncology, nephrology, and ICU wards.
Developed a renal diet education module adopted hospital-wide, reducing diet-related readmissions by 19%.
Lead monthly nutrition grand rounds and supervise 3 dietetic interns per rotation.
Collaborate with the multidisciplinary team on nutrition support protocols and parenteral nutrition orders.

experience.title: Community Nutrition Officer
responsibilities: Coordinated nutrition programs across 12 municipalities serving 60,000+ beneficiaries.
Trained 180 barangay health workers on complementary feeding, micronutrient supplementation, and IMCI.
Authored the Regional Operation Timbang monitoring report submitted to the National Nutrition Council.
Spearheaded a school-based feeding program pilot that improved wasting prevalence by 23% in target schools.

experience.title: Dietitian I
experience.company: Jose B. Lingad Memorial Regional Hospital
responsibilities: Conducted nutritional assessments and diet counselling for outpatient and inpatient clients.
Assisted in diet order verification and therapeutic meal planning in the food service department.
Participated in the hospital quality improvement committee on malnutrition screening protocols.
